SmartWings’ Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale starts November 15, 2026, with 10% off sitewide or 15% off orders over $1,500. The featured custom motorized shades on sale are available in a variety of styles, including roller, cellular, and linen Roman, to suit different rooms and design preferences.

For Apple Home users, choosing a compatible motor adds another way to automate the house: open your shades in the morning, close them in the evening, or adjust them with a voice command. Check out the styles included in the sale and discover what to consider when choosing the right shades for your windows.

Three styles to consider

The starting prices below are calculated by applying the upcoming 10% sitewide discount to SmartWings’ current listed base prices. Final pricing varies with window dimensions, motor, and other configuration choices; select a compatible motor if you want Apple Home integration.

Roller shades for a clean, modern look

This Black Friday, enjoy 10% off sitewide or 15% off orders over $1,500, including the Safari motorized roller shades.

Safari pairs a minimalist roller design with fabric that blocks approximately 70% of incoming light. It’s a practical option for living rooms, home offices, and other everyday spaces where you want to soften daylight, with motorized adjustments as the light changes throughout the day.

Cellular shades for light filtering and insulation

The Nowa motorized cellular shades combines light-filtering fabric with honeycomb construction designed to help reduce heat transfer through windows. For bedrooms, living rooms, and home offices, it brings together softer light, insulation benefits, and convenient motorized control.

Linen Roman shades for a softer finish

For a more decorative fabric treatment, the Daphne motorized linen Roman shades combines linen-style texture with classic Roman shade folds. Its 50%, 70%, and 100% blackout options let you choose the light control that suits the room, while motorized operation adds modern convenience to a traditional window treatment.

Custom sizing, with your choice of smart home control

SmartWings shades are made to order using your window measurements and selected configuration. You can choose different fabrics, colors, and light-control options for each room, along with a motor suited to your smart home setup.

Compatible options support Apple Home, Matter, Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings. This means you can use apps, voice commands, remote controls, schedules, and automated routines to manage your shades.

The Black Friday and Cyber Monday savings begin November 15, whether you’re starting with one room or putting together a larger home upgrade. For more design ideas, follow SmartWings on Instagram and Facebook.
